_note: Single source of truth for Ansu boons (there are no banes; the system's teeth are control, not prices). Names and descriptions are authored in English (GM directive). Number tokens: {{ansuReleaseDC}}, {{ansuCallDC}}, {{ansuTempHp}}, {{ansuResist}}, {{ansuParry}}, {{ansuTierDice}}, {{ansuLevel}}, {{ansuDuration}}, {{ansuRecallRange}}, {{ansuRecalls}}, {{ansuThrowInc}}, baked at compose time and recomputed on attunement, loyalty or character-level change.
_designNote: GM-approved ladder rev 3.2 (2026-07-07). `form: feat` + `always: true` = Inheritance (permanent bonus feats in the Feats tab); everything else exists only during Communion (actives materialize on Invoke and vanish on release, except `alwaysAvailable`, the Invoke action itself). `perCommunion` frequency resets via item recreation; `cooldownMinutes` is a module-owned world-time cooldown that survives re-invokes. The metal is Salbarium (Сальбарий).

entries.name: Invoke the Ansu
entries.description:
Requirements You are not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}, no lockout is running, and the Ansu does not hold your body.

You draw the Ansu's strength into your body. Attempt an Athletics check against the Call DC ({{ansuCallDC}}): 20 + 2 × attunement, 2 higher when the Ansu is hostile, 1 higher when it is cold, and 1 lower when it trusts you.

  • Critical Success Communion begins for its longest length (10 rounds at Trial and Discipline, 100 rounds at Union).
  • Success Communion begins (3 rounds at Trial, 5 at Discipline, 10 at Union).
  • Failure The Ansu answers grudgingly. Communion begins for its shortest length (1 round at Trial, 2 at Discipline, 3 at Union), and the DC to send it back is 2 higher.
  • Critical Failure No Communion. You attempt the release save at once, and the Ansu won't answer another Call for 1 minute.

Every Communion active appears on your sheet with the buff and leaves when Communion ends. Ending Communion, early or when it runs out, takes a Fortitude save against the release DC ({{ansuReleaseDC}}, +2 after a failed Call). From attunement 2, a successful Invoke includes a free Stride (Bull's Footing). At Mastery the Call is no longer rolled.

entries.name: Release the Ansu
entries.description:
Requirements Communion is active.

You let the borrowed strength go. Attempt a Fortitude save against the release DC ({{ansuReleaseDC}}, +2 after a failed Call). The same save is posted on its own when Communion runs out.

  • Critical Success You let go cleanly. Communion ends.
  • Success As critical success.
  • Failure Communion ends and your muscles tear on the way down: you lose Hit Points equal to twice your attunement. This is not damage, so temporary Hit Points and resistances don't reduce it, and it never takes you below 1 Hit Point.
  • Critical Failure Communion ends, you lose Hit Points equal to four times your attunement (never below 1), you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}, and the Ansu won't answer your Call until the lockout ends: your next night's rest at Trial, 1 hour at Discipline, 10 minutes at Union.

entries.name: Ancestral Vigor
entries.description: The Ansu's strength pours into muscle and bone. When you Invoke the Ansu, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to {{ansuTempHp}}, and you gain a +2 status bonus to melee damage rolls while Communion lasts.

entries.name: Maker's Wrath
entries.description:
The arena blow, learned. Make a melee Strike that deals {{ansuTierDice}}d6 extra damage of your weapon's damage type (1d6 at Trial, 2d6 at Discipline, 3d6 at Union). On a critical hit, the target is also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Automation: switch on the Maker's Wrath toggle before the Strike; the extra dice add themselves. Switch it off after.

entries.name: Bull's Footing
entries.description: Hooves strike the ground like hammers on an anvil. You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed, and a successful Invoke of the Ansu lets you immediately Stride as a free action, the Ansu lunging into the world. When you Stride in a straight line toward an enemy, you ignore non-magical difficult terrain.

rules.title: Bull's Footing
rules.text: A successful Invoke of the Ansu includes a free Stride. Striding in a straight line toward an enemy: ignore non-magical difficult terrain.

entries.name: Tongue of the Makers
entries.description:
The Ansu murmurs the old words until they are yours. You can speak, read, and write Murkhor and recognize the maker-glyphs of your people. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to Decipher Writing and to Recall Knowledge checks about murkhor works, ruins, and devices.

This knowledge stays even while the Ansu sleeps.

rules.title: Tongue of the Makers
rules.text: Knows Murkhor. +1 circumstance to Decipher Writing and Recall Knowledge about murkhor works.

entries.name: Call the Blade
entries.description:
Requirements You have a hand free.

The bound blade flies back to your hand from as far as {{ansuRecallRange}} feet. On the way it smashes through thin barriers: wood, plaster, glass, a plank door. A stone or metal wall stops it. If a creature is holding the blade, it strains toward you but doesn't tear free.

Uses per Communion: {{ansuRecalls}}.

The Salbarium in the blade's core answers the bearer's will. That is a property of the metal, not a spell.

entries.name: Throw the Blade
entries.description:
You hurl the bound blade. Make a ranged @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VjxZFuUXrCU94MWR]{Strike} with it that uses your melee attack modifier and adds your Strength modifier to damage. The range increment is {{ansuThrowInc}} feet, with the usual -2 penalty for each additional increment, up to six increments.

You can throw farther than you can recall. The blade stays where it lands until you Call the Blade or someone carries it back.

entries.name: Blade's Return
entries.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Requirements You have a hand free.

The bound blade flies back to your hand from up to 30 feet away, even when Communion is not running. The bearer learned this much from the Ansu, and it stays.

entries.name: Horns Reforged
entries.description: What the Ansu broke, the Ansu rebuilds, while it stays close. During Communion your shattered horns knit into whole ridged weapons: you gain a horns unarmed attack that deals 1d10 piercing damage and has the shove trait. When Communion ends, they crumble back to stumps.

entries.name: Fair Battle
entries.description:
Requirements Three or more enemies are within your melee reach.

The Ansu remembers the arena: five against one was never unfair, only arithmetic. Make one melee Strike and compare the attack roll result to the AC of each enemy within your melee reach. The Strike deals 10 extra damage; roll that damage once and apply it to each target you hit. This counts as one attack for your multiple attack penalty.

Automation: switch on the Fair Battle toggle before the Strike; the 10 extra damage adds itself. Switch it off after.

entries.name: Salbarine Skin
entries.description: A pale metal sheen spreads over hide and scar, the same gleam as the Ansu's ornaments. You gain resistance {{ansuResist}} to physical damage (3 at attunement 5, 4 at 7, 5 at 9).

entries.name: Salbarine Parry
entries.description:
Trigger An attack hits you.

The sheen hardens into plate where the blow lands: you gain resistance to all damage against the triggering attack equal to {{ansuParry}}.

entries.name: Engineer's Eye
entries.description:
You begin to see the world the way your people built it: as mechanism. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Recall Knowledge checks about constructs, traps, and mechanisms, and to Thievery checks to Disable a Device on mechanical devices.

This knowledge stays even while the Ansu sleeps.

rules.title: Engineer's Eye
rules.text: +1 circumstance to Recall Knowledge about constructs, traps, and mechanisms.

entries.name: Overwhelm
entries.description:
One blow, the way the Ansu fights. Make a melee Strike. If it hits, the target is automatically pushed 5 feet or knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} (your choice, no check). On a critical hit, both happen, and the push is 10 feet.

(This is the arena, where even the mightiest foe drops to a single perfect blow.)

entries.name: Hurl the Blade
entries.description:
Throw the Blade improves. When the thrown blade hits, you can Call the Blade as a free action; this still spends one of its uses. On a critical hit, the target also takes 1d6 persistent bleed damage.

At attunement 3 a throw and a catch cost three actions. From attunement 6 they cost two.
entries.chipTag: free catch on a hit · crit bleed

entries.name: Ansu's Stature
entries.description: You carry the Ansu's presence rather than its bulk. Your reach with melee Strikes increases by 5 feet, as the space around you belongs to something larger than your body. Your size, square, and gear stay unchanged.

rules.title: Ansu's Stature
rules.text: Melee reach +5 feet while Communion lasts (no size change).

entries.name: The Ansu Refuses
entries.description:
Trigger You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points while Communion lasts.

The Ansu does not permit the vessel to break, and it answers. You remain at 1 Hit Point, you immediately make one melee Strike against the creature that reduced you to 0 Hit Points (if it is within your melee reach), and you increase your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} condition by 1: the body keeps the bill.

You can't use this reaction again for 10 minutes.

entries.name: Ancestral Vigor (Union)
entries.description: The Ansu's strength pours into muscle and bone. When you Invoke the Ansu, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to {{ansuTempHp}}, and you gain a +3 status bonus to melee damage rolls while Communion lasts.

entries.name: Roar of the Old Blood
entries.description:
A sound out of a dead civilization's pride. Attempt an Intimidation check to Demoralize each enemy within 30 feet. You don't take the penalty for a target that doesn't understand you, and your result against each target is one degree of success better. On a critical success the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round instead of Frightened 2.

Once per Communion.

entries.name: Mind Like a Forge
entries.description: The Ansu drives the body faster than deliberation. While Communion lasts, you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} and can use the extra action each round only for Stride and Strike actions.

rules.title: Mind Like a Forge
rules.text: Quickened: the extra action is only for Stride or Strike.

entries.name: Permanent Communion
entries.description: There is no longer a door to hold shut, only you, larger inside than before. Communion no longer expires and never requires a Release save. You can enter or end it as a free action once per turn. Every Communion boon and Inheritance is simply yours now.

entries.name: Salbarine Chain
entries.description:
Requirements You have a hand free.

You pull the Salbarium from your inlays into a chain fixed to your wrist. It lasts until Communion ends or you drop it as a free action. While it lasts:

  • You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} a creature up to 60 feet away, with the usual Athletics check. A successful Grapple drags the creature 10 feet toward you (20 feet on a critical success).
  • You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact} at up to 60 feet: pull a lever, or snatch an unattended object of light Bulk.
  • Anchor 1 You hook a solid point within 60 feet and haul yourself there. This is a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Bcxarzksqt9ezrs6]{Stride} that ignores gaps and difficult terrain and can run up a wall.

The chain is an object (Hardness 15, 60 Hit Points) and needs a clear path.
